### DashboardV2 <a name="DashboardV2" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2"></a>

Represents a {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.8.0/docs/resources/dashboard_v2 datadog_dashboard_v2}.

#### Initializers <a name="Initializers" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.Initializer"></a>

```python

  scope: Construct,
  id: str,
  connection: SSHProvisionerConnection | WinrmProvisionerConnection = None,
  count: typing.Union[int, float] | TerraformCount = None,
  depends_on: typing.List[ITerraformDependable] = None,
  for_each: ITerraformIterator = None,
  lifecycle: TerraformResourceLifecycle = None,
  provider: TerraformProvider = None,
  provisioners: typing.List[FileProvisioner | LocalExecProvisioner | RemoteExecProvisioner] = None,
  layout_type: str,
  title: str,
  dashboard_lists: typing.List[typing.Union[int, float]] = None,
  dashboard_lists_removed: typing.List[typing.Union[int, float]] = None,
  description: str = None,
  id: str = None,
  is_read_only: bool | IResolvable = None,
  notify_list: typing.List[str] = None,
  reflow_type: str = None,
  restricted_roles: typing.List[str] = None,
  tab: IResolvable | typing.List[DashboardV2Tab] = None,
  tags: typing.List[str] = None,
  template_variable: IResolvable | typing.List[DashboardV2TemplateVariable] = None,

)
```

##### `is_read_only`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="is_read_only" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.Initializer.parameter.isReadOnly"></a>

- *Type:* bool | cdktn.IResolvable

Whether this dashboard is read-only.

**Deprecated.** This field is deprecated and non-functional. Use `restricted_roles` instead to define which roles are required to edit the dashboard. Defaults to `false`.

Docs at Terraform Registry: {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.8.0/docs/resources/dashboard_v2#is_read_only DashboardV2#is_read_only}

- *Type:* typing.List[str]

The list of handles for the users to notify when changes are made to this dashboard.

Docs at Terraform Registry: {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.8.0/docs/resources/dashboard_v2#notify_list DashboardV2#notify_list}

---

##### `reflow_type`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="reflow_type" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.Initializer.parameter.reflowType"></a>

- *Type:* str

The reflow type of a new dashboard layout.

Set this only when layout type is `ordered`. If set to `fixed`, the dashboard expects all widgets to have a layout, and if it's set to `auto`, widgets should not have layouts. Valid values are `auto`, `fixed`.

Docs at Terraform Registry: {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.8.0/docs/resources/dashboard_v2#reflow_type DashboardV2#reflow_type}

---

- *Type:* typing.List[str]

A list of role identifiers.

Only the author and users associated with at least one of these roles can edit this dashboard.

Docs at Terraform Registry: {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.8.0/docs/resources/dashboard_v2#restricted_roles DashboardV2#restricted_roles}

##### `with` <a name="with" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.with"></a>

```python
def with(
  mixins: *IMixin
) -> IConstruct
```

Applies one or more mixins to this construct.

Mixins are applied in order. The list of constructs is captured at the
start of the call, so constructs added by a mixin will not be visited.
Use multiple `with()` calls if subsequent mixins should apply to added
constructs.

##### `is_construct` <a name="is_construct" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.isConstruct"></a>

```python
from cdktn_provider_datadog import dashboard_v2

dashboardV2.DashboardV2.is_construct(
  x: typing.Any
)
```

Checks if `x` is a construct.

Use this method instead of `instanceof` to properly detect `Construct`
instances, even when the construct library is symlinked.

Explanation: in JavaScript, multiple copies of the `constructs` library on
disk are seen as independent, completely different libraries. As a
consequence, the class `Construct` in each copy of the `constructs` library
is seen as a different class, and an instance of one class will not test as
`instanceof` the other class. `npm install` will not create installations
like this, but users may manually symlink construct libraries together or
use a monorepo tool: in those cases, multiple copies of the `constructs`
library can be accidentally installed, and `instanceof` will behave
unpredictably. It is safest to avoid using `instanceof`, and using
this type-testing method instead.

###### `x`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="x" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboardV2.DashboardV2.isConstruct.parameter.x"></a>

- *Type:* typing.Any

Any object.
